content.text: SubjectsExploreDonateSign InSign Up .10 is what percent?Flexi Says: Decimals and percentages are two forms of numbers. We use percentages to compare things since they always count out of 100. Steps to Convert Decimal into a Percent Step 1: Move the decimal point two places to the right. Add zeros to the right of the decimal point as placeholders, if necessary. Step 2: Write a percent symbol ( % ) symbol after the resulting number. So, to find what is 0.1 as a percent, first, move the decimal point two places to the right. Then, add the percent sign. This decimal is written in tenth because there is 1 digit after the decimal point. You only need to move the decimal point two places to the right to make it a percent. So, 0.1=10% The percent form of 0.1 is written as 10%.
